predictor.notes: Retained unchanged: all 96 additional probes were consistent, providing no evidence-supported coefficient improvement. Across both rounds, this predictor reproduces all 188 rounded responses at their 100000-pence precision and the exact approved/export prices of 68387 pence at quantity 50 and 127037 pence at quantity 200. Sampling now covers 187 distinct quantities, with at most seven between consecutive sampled quantities; no additional rounded-price transitions were found. The boundary at 201 and subsequent curvature remain modeling choices, not identified tariff parameters. Exact reconstruction is still underdetermined: alternative monotone piecewise models matching every response predict 150091 versus 249695 pence at quantity 1000. Unobserved quantities and within-rounding-bin structure remain uncertain. Cumulative usage: 192 business requests and 16 REA operations.
